app.title: Greg Kurtzer's Ginux is now a userspace kernel
app.description: A Linux kernel rewritten to run entirely in userspace, providing a sandboxed execution environment.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run provided build script to compile the kernel
Boot the userspace kernel with a simple init process and verify it can spawn a /bin/sh
Run a small program that performs file I/O and network I/O inside the kernel and compare latency to a native kernel
